name: obsidian-singularity
description: Obsidian void and cosmic purple singularity backdrop with explosive crystalline shard dynamics for high-impact NouGen surfaces.
referenceWorld: Gravitational singularities, Kerr black hole accretion physics, obsidian volcanic glass fractures, and deep-space ultraviolet nebulae.
antiPatterns: Avoid flat matte gray backgrounds, low-contrast washed purple gradients, jittery un-interpolated particles, cartoon stars, and generic SaaS hero blobs.
materiality: Ultra-dense obsidian carbon substrates with crystalline faceted glass shards, ultraviolet refraction fringes, and specular violet event-horizon rims.
density: Deep spatial immersion with focused central focal density. Background telemetry and controls maintain an ergonomic 12px-14px hierarchy with high-contrast isolation.
motionGrammar: Gravitational orbital decay, explosive relativistic outward shockwaves, dampening Newtonian particle dispersion, and subtle 60fps accretion shimmer.
interactionPhysics: Pointer acts as a dynamic gravitational anomaly; left click detonates a core collapse supernova; interactive controls respond with zero-latency spring physics.
informationHierarchy: The visual hierarchy prioritizes the central singularity event horizon and primary UI layers over secondary cosmic dust particles and telemetry HUD overlays.
responsiveBehavior: Particle field and canvas automatically scale across full viewport aspect ratios from mobile 360px portrait up to 4K ultra-wide displays without aspect ratio distortion.
accessibility: High-contrast WCAG AAA compliance on all foreground elements against the obsidian background (minimum 7:1 ratio for text). Motion disable toggle provided for reduced-motion preferences.
brandVoice: Cosmic, authoritative, precise, and uncompromisingly premium. Reflects deep-tier NouGen technological supremacy.
iconography: Crisp geometric wireframe glyphs, faceted shard geometry, and minimalist astronomical vector markers.
dataViz: Dynamic telemetry gauges for particle count, gravitational flux, velocity vectors, and framerate stability.
stateGrammar: Supports quiescent singularity state, accretion charge state, supernova explosion burst, gravitational collapse, and interactive warp modes.
provenance: Engineered for NouGenDesign dialect v0 and Google Stitch DESIGN.md compatibility, incorporating NouGenMorph OKLCH color spaces and Nyx UI motion mechanics.
